decision.reason: [ev-f445c4712c8b] is a one-line changelog entry. It names the subject (Argo CD's Dex integration) and the change (it now always requests the `federated:id` scope). For anything more it points only to PRs #17908 and #21726. It does not say which configurations were affected before, for example which Dex connectors or SSO setups failed to request the scope. It also does not say what happens to an exposed environment, such as a change in token claims or RBAC subject matching, so neither applicability nor consequence can be written from it.
